title: 第612章 故人相见大战开始第611章 两军对峙伏羲无奈
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
西天门外，亿万妖军与天庭联军隔着茫茫云海遥遥对峙。
两股截然不同的浩瀚气息在虚空中疯狂倾轧，将方圆亿万里的云海尽数碾作齑粉，杀机如弦，仿佛只需一阵微风，便能引爆这毁天灭地的风暴。
就在此时，西天门内，一道浩荡的神光从东方虚空中破空而来。
一道古老而苍茫的威压伴随着神光一同落下，压在西天门外正前方的云海之上，如同在山谷中堆叠的尘埃被一阵风卷起之后缓慢落下，重新覆盖了周围的云层表面。
伏羲的身影从神光中踏出，脚下的云层在他落地的瞬间向四周均匀散开，形成一圈与他的步幅等宽的平整区域。
他的身后，蛇族精锐的阵列沿着那道神光的方向依次显现。
伏羲脚踏祥云向前迈出数步，古朴道袍的下摆在他行进时轻轻扫过云面。
他面容威严，目光穿过两军之间的云海，穿过层层阵列之间密集的气息交错，落在妖军阵营中央那道高悬于半空的帝辇之上。
太一的面容在帝辇投下的阴影中半明半暗，目光与伏羲交汇于那片云海之上的虚空中。
太一的目光在伏羲的面容上停驻了片刻，缓缓从帝座上站起身来
“伏羲……你终于出现了。”
太一的声音既非带着全然的敌意，也非有着全然的亲近，那语气中透着几分故人重逢的唏嘘，上古时期，太一为帝，伏羲为相，二人曾并肩统御万族，何等的风光岁月，如今都已是旧时云烟。
伏羲负手而立，目光与太一对视，没有因为那语气中的旧日余韵而产生任何的波动。
“太一，你我相识于微末，也曾并肩立于洪荒之巅。彼时的你，眼中是洪荒万族的存续与安稳，而非今日这般睥睨众生的孤傲。
我知你不甘，也知道这一战在你心中早已等了许久。但如今大势已定，天庭承接天道正统，乃是此纪元不可逆转的走向。你今日伐天，纵然能逞一时之威，可待到混沌中诸位圣人归来。
天道清算之下，你和你麾下的整个妖族，都将万劫不复。”
“听我一句劝，即刻退兵，收敛锋芒。这是你如今唯一还能保留的退路。一旦战火真正点燃，便再无回旋的余地了。”
太一听着伏羲的话，喉咙深处涌出一阵低沉的笑声，在云海上缓慢地散开。那笑声中没有半分悔意，只有万古蛰伏后破茧而出的决绝与孤傲。
“退路。”
太一重复了一遍那两个字。他的目光从伏羲面上短暂地移开了一瞬，落在两军之间那片被双方威压共同压平的云海上，云海表面平整如镜，倒映着星光与旌旗的剪影。

“自封神量劫、古妖庭崩塌的那一日起，我便已经没有了退路。你站在天庭的阵线上，看得见那所谓的天道正统，却看不到洪荒的每一次定数都在为更强的力量留出腾挪的空间。
天道既然要舍弃我等，那我太一便用这亿万妖军的血，重新杀出一条通天大道。圣人若归来——我便踏碎他的圣位。”
“伏羲，你乃我妖族绝顶之才，与其在这腐朽的天庭做一尊被束之高阁的傀儡大帝，不如重新归于我的麾下。
待我重登天帝之位，再定洪荒乾坤，你依旧是勾陈大帝，与我共掌这无上荣光。你我联手，何愁大业不成？”
伏羲的面色在太一话音落定的过程中持续变冷。
“道不同，不相为谋。你眼中只有夺回旧日权柄，却看不见如今苍生所需的安宁。你所谓的大业，不过是踩着无尽尸骨与逆天而行的狂志堆成的虚影。我伏羲，宁为天庭的守关之将，也绝不做你逆天伪朝的从龙之臣。”
伏羲声音落地之后，在云海上方持续了片刻，太一的面色也在伏羲最后那句话落定的瞬间彻底变冷了。
他缓缓收回了目光，不再与伏羲对视，将视线投向两军之间那片依旧保持平整的云海。他没有再开口，但最后一丝故人情谊已被冰冷的杀意彻底取代。
伏羲亦不再多言，周身属于勾陈大帝的浩瀚神力轰然爆发，与身后蛇族大军融为一体，化作一道坚不可摧的壁垒。至此，所有的言语都失去了意义。
“妖族儿郎们，给我杀——！！！”
白泽拔剑指天，亿万妖军化作毁天灭地的黑色洪流，朝着西天门疯狂席卷而去。

content_en:
Outside the West Heaven Gate, hundreds of millions of demon troops and the Heavenly Allied Forces were facing each other across the vast sea of ​​clouds.
Two completely different vast auras collided crazily in the void, grinding all the sea of ​​clouds with a radius of hundreds of millions of miles into powder, with murderous intent, as if just a breeze could detonate this storm that would destroy the world.
At this moment, inside the West Heaven Gate, a mighty divine light broke through the sky from the east.
An ancient and vast coercion fell together with the divine light, pressing on the sea of ​​clouds directly in front of the West Tianmen. It was like dust piled up in the valley that was picked up by a gust of wind and then slowly fell, covering the surface of the surrounding clouds again.
Fuxi's figure stepped out of the divine light, and the clouds under his feet spread evenly around him the moment he landed, forming a flat area that was as wide as his stride.
Behind him, the elite arrays of the snake clan appeared one after another along the direction of the divine light.
Fuxi stepped forward on the auspicious clouds and took a few steps forward. The hem of his simple Taoist robe gently swept across the clouds as he walked.
His face was majestic, and his gaze passed through the sea of ​​clouds between the two armies, through the dense interweaving of auras between the layers of arrays, and landed on the imperial chariot hanging high in the air in the center of the demon army camp.
Taiyi's face was half-dark in the shadow cast by the emperor's chariot, and his eyes met Fuxi's in the void above the sea of ​​clouds.
Taiyi's eyes lingered on Fuxi's face for a moment, and he slowly stood up from the throne.
"Fuxi...you finally showed up."
Taiyi's voice was neither full of hostility nor full of closeness. There was a hint of sadness in the tone of old friends reunited. In ancient times, Taiyi was the emperor and Fuxi was the prime minister. The two once ruled all races side by side. Such glorious years are now a thing of the past.
Fuxi stood with his hands behind his hands, looking at Tai, without any fluctuation due to the lingering charm of the past in his tone.
"Taiyi, you and I have known each other since we were young, and we once stood side by side on the top of the ancient world. At that time, your eyes were on the survival and stability of all races in the ancient world, instead of being so aloof and arrogant as you are today.
I know you are unwilling to give in, and I also know that you have been waiting for this battle in your heart for a long time. But now the general trend has been decided. The inheritance of the orthodoxy of Heavenly Court is the irreversible trend of this era. You attack the sky today, even if you can show off your power for a while, you can wait until the saints from the chaos return.
Under heaven's reckoning, you and the entire demon clan under your command will be doomed. "
"Listen to my advice, retreat immediately and rein in your strength. This is the only retreat you can keep now. Once the war is really ignited, there will be no room for maneuver."
When Taiyi listened to Fuxi's words, a deep laughter surged from the depths of his throat, slowly spreading across the sea of clouds. There was no regret in that laughter, only determination and arrogance that broke out of the cocoon after being dormant for eternity.
"Escape."
Taiyi repeated those two words. His eyes briefly moved away from Fuxi's face for a moment, and fell on the sea of ​​clouds between the two armies that was flattened by the pressure of both sides. The surface of the sea of ​​clouds was as flat as a mirror, reflecting the silhouettes of stars and flags.
"Ever since the day when the gods were called to measure the calamity and the Ancient Demon Court collapsed, I had no way out. You stand on the front line of the heaven, and you can see the so-called orthodoxy of heaven, but you can't see that every destiny in the prehistoric times leaves room for stronger power.
Since Heaven wants to abandon us, then I, Taiyi, will use the blood of these hundreds of millions of demonic armies to create a new avenue to the sky. If the saint returns - I will crush his throne. "
"Fuxi, you are the most talented person in our demon clan. Instead of being a puppet emperor who is shelved in this decadent heaven, it is better for you to return to my command.
When I return to the position of Emperor of Heaven and determine the future of the world, you will still be the Great Emperor Gouchen, sharing this supreme glory with me. If you and I join forces, why worry about failure? "
Fuxi's face continued to grow colder as Taiyi finished speaking.
"We have different ways and do not work together. In your eyes, you only want to regain the old power, but youI can't see the peace that people need now. Your so-called great cause is nothing more than a shadow piled up by endless corpses and crazy ambitions that go against heaven. I, Fu Xi, would rather be a guard general of the Heavenly Court than a minister of the dragon who defies heaven and your puppet dynasty. "
After Fuxi's voice fell to the ground, it lasted for a moment above the sea of clouds. Taiyi's face turned completely cold the moment Fuxi's last words came to light.
He slowly withdrew his gaze, no longer looking at Fuxi, and turned his gaze to the sea of clouds that remained flat between the two armies. He didn't speak again, but the last trace of old friendship had been completely replaced by cold murderous intent.
Fuxi said no more, and the vast divine power belonging to Emperor Gouchen exploded around him, merging with the snake army behind him and turning into an indestructible barrier. At this point, all words have lost their meaning.
"You demon tribesmen, kill me——! ! ! "
Bai Ze drew his sword and pointed at the sky, and the hundreds of millions of demon army turned into a black torrent that destroyed the world and swept towards the West Tianmen crazily.
